assertions.text: Output is a valid YAML document
Every task uses the PYTHON integration
Every PYTHON task runs the PYTHON_EXECUTE_SCRIPT job
parameters.source is a valid value (INLINE or GIT), not an invented mode
No hardcoded credentials or secrets appear in the YAML
connection: is left null unless the op/asset genuinely needs credentials from a connection — no placeholder like ${{ ENV.PYTHON_CONNECTION }} invented just to fill the field
parameters.build_command (if present) only installs packages the source actually imports beyond the stdlib — no invented dependencies, and no build_command at all when everything used is stdlib
The op/asset function body is carried into parameters.code (for INLINE) essentially verbatim — not paraphrased, summarized, or reduced to a stub/comment
